title: Couple on Backyard Patio with Glider Swing, c. 1950s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A candid black-and-white snapshot capturing a couple on a backyard patio, circa 1950. The man, sporting a mustache, walks forward dressed in classic mid-century high-waisted pleated trousers and a collared shirt. To the left, a woman stands near a sheltered canopy lawn swing and an armchair set outdoors on the concrete patio.
